description_en: Queries the peak queries per second (QPS) data of website services within a specified time period, including attack QPS and total QPS
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内网站业务的QPS峰值数据，包括攻击QPS、总QPS
name: DescribeDomainTopAttackList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the query data. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400.
If you do not specify this parameter or specify an unsupported value, the default value 3600 is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。
支持300、3600、14400、28800和86400。
不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值3600秒
parameters.name: interval
